note: Amendment I: model calls routed via OpenRouter (provider block lives in the per-run CODEX_HOME config, not ~/.codex). Amendment J: enabled_tools = ["select"] restricts the server to its search+fetch tool; pilot verifies Codex 0.147.0 honours it.

setup_files.codex-home/config.toml:
model = "openai/gpt-5.6-terra"
model_provider = "openrouter"
approval_policy = "never"
sandbox_mode = "read-only"
web_search = "disabled"

[model_providers.openrouter]
name = "OpenRouter"
base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"
env_key = "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"
wire_api = "responses"

[mcp_servers.keenable]
url = "{KEENABLE_MCP_URL}"
http_headers = { "X-API-Key" = "{KEENABLE_API_KEY}" }
enabled_tools = ["select"]
default_tools_approval_mode = "approve"
tool_timeout_sec = 120
